against_battery.miscalibration: EVIDENCE AGAINST if, for EITHER group with >= min_informative_items informative items, the stream has >= against_min_days matured freeze days, |gap| >= against_min_abs_gap, and the against_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap excludes 0. gap > 0 = LP lost to holding MORE often than forecast (the dangerous direction).

fixed_rule.cadence: One verdict every 28 days, judged on the CUMULATIVE matured record since the first freeze (verdict k covers freeze days 1..28k). Earlier verdicts are never revised.
calibrated_conditions_all_required: for EVERY group with >= min_informative_items informative items: the calibrated_ci block-bootstrap interval of gap lies entirely inside [-calibration_tolerance, +calibration_tolerance]
at least one group has both outcomes among its informative items
fixed_rule.evaluation_order: INVALID first; then EVIDENCE AGAINST; then CALIBRATED; else UNTESTED. The first that fires decides.
fixed_rule.forecast_object: For every pool in xrpl_v2/universe.json (XRP / issued-token constant-product AMMs on the XRP Ledger, fixed at seal; the file's sha256 is in every row), frozen once per UTC day at 16:00 UTC: p_lose = P(LP-vs-HOLD net < 0 over the next 14 days) and p_lose1 = P(net < -1%). net = (fi1/fi0) * 2*sqrt(r)/(1+r) - 1 with fi = sqrt(R_xrp*R_tok)/S_lp and r the ratio of XRP-per-token prices - exact from reserves, including real fees and fee votes. Champion XV-B1: the pool's CURRENT fee factor (trailing 7 days of the on-chain daily points at 00:00 UTC, x2) combined with each of its trailing 730 historical 14-day price moves (daily on-chain points from the full-history ledger). Pools with < 365 own starts use XV-P1: the pooled, standardized 14-day moves of the long-history pools rescaled to the pool's own trailing-60-day volatility (labelled short history, still tiered, still graded). Challenger XV-H1 (graded, never the headline): the pool's own historical realized 14-day nets.
invalid_battery: any frozen row whose window_start_ts differs from its created_at_ts
INCOMPLETE rows exceeding incomplete_max_share of the stream's matured rows
the stream froze on fewer than running_min_share of the calendar days in the judged period
any row whose prediction_hash does not recompute from its own fields
fixed_rule.outcome: realized net between the first collector sample at/after created_at_ts (<= 600 s later) and the first sample at/after that start + 14 days (<= 600 s later), computed from reserves and LP supply. y_lose = net < 0; y_lose1 = net < -0.01. A missing start or end sample makes the row INCOMPLETE. Recomputed at grade time from the stored samples.

protocol_constants.gap_definition: gap(width) = mean over resolved items of (breach - p)
protocol_constants.informative_item: an item with 0.02 <= p <= 0.98 (near-certain forecasts are excluded from the tests but shown in the reliability table)

reported_not_gated: Brier and Brier skill vs climatology per group

CHALLENGER SCOREBOARD XV-H1 vs XV-B1 per group. Promotion (pre-committed): XV-H1 replaces XV-B1 only if, over >= 120 matured freeze days, its Brier skill on 'lose' is >= 5% with the 95% block CI excluding 0 AND it is not worse (point estimate) on 'lose1'. A promotion is a new sealed model version; never back-applied.
exp_net, net percentiles, fee14 and exp_il are displayed and not graded by this standard
fixed_rule.serial_dependence: Daily 14-day windows overlap and pools co-move with XRP, so rows are NOT independent. All inference resamples whole freeze DAYS in moving blocks of 14 consecutive days (2000 resamples, seed 42).

notes: Seal BEFORE the first xrpl-v2.0.0 freeze. Spec: docs/design/XRPL_V2_SPEC.md. Supersedes XRPL-MC and Pool IQ (their records stand as published).
one_line_commitment: Every day, for every universe XRPL AMM pool, the probability that LP loses to holding over the next 14 days (and loses more than 1%) is frozen before the window opens; the cumulative record is judged mechanically on calibration with serial-dependence-aware inference, and every result is published including misses.
